client/src/lib/app-code-platform/compone.name: App building blocks
client/src/lib/app-code-platform/compone.description: Gives app code ready-made buttons, cards, inputs, tables and dialogs that match the platform's look.

client/src/lib/app-code-platform/index.t.name: App runtime features
client/src/lib/app-code-platform/index.t.description: Collects everything handed to app code: navigation, data hooks, person details and shared memory.

client/src/lib/app-code-platform/navigat.name: App navigation
client/src/lib/app-code-platform/navigat.description: Moves someone between an app's pages while keeping them inside the app's own address.

client/src/lib/app-code-platform/navigat.name: App page links
client/src/lib/app-code-platform/navigat.description: Provides link and redirect pieces that keep an app's pages under the app's own address.

client/src/lib/app-code-platform/Require.name: Role-only content
client/src/lib/app-code-platform/Require.description: Shows a piece of an app only to people holding a given role.

client/src/lib/app-code-platform/scope.t.name: App feature bundle
client/src/lib/app-code-platform/scope.t.description: Assembles the full set of platform features handed to app code when it runs.

client/src/lib/app-code-platform/useAppS.name: Page-to-page memory
client/src/lib/app-code-platform/useAppS.description: Remembers choices as someone moves between an app's pages, and clears them when the app closes.

client/src/lib/app-code-platform/useLoca.name: Current page address
client/src/lib/app-code-platform/useLoca.description: Tells app code which page it is on, relative to the app's own address.

client/src/lib/app-code-platform/usePara.name: Address values
client/src/lib/app-code-platform/usePara.description: Reads the changing parts of a page address, such as a customer number.

client/src/lib/app-code-platform/useSear.name: Address filters
client/src/lib/app-code-platform/useSear.description: Reads and sets filter values carried in a page address.

client/src/lib/app-code-platform/useUser.name: Signed-in person
client/src/lib/app-code-platform/useUser.description: Tells app code who is signed in, including their name, email and roles.

client/src/lib/app-code-platform/useWork.name: Workflow action hook
client/src/lib/app-code-platform/useWork.description: Runs a workflow when someone acts, and reports progress, results and errors to the screen.

client/src/lib/app-code-platform/useWork.name: Workflow data hook
client/src/lib/app-code-platform/useWork.description: Loads a workflow's result for a screen and refreshes it when its inputs change.
